skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content: The cold, hardy machine is equipped with a witchcraft curse device, which emits a soft red glow. She brings the leisurely, distant ballads of the Banshees and the many concerns of the elders.

skins.name: Primordial Ode
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Primordial Ode. PhonoR-0 is draped in the lace veil her sisters embroidered with incantations, singing an ode above the Valley. The Banshees have finally found their voice once more.
skins.usage: One of PhonoR-0's modifications for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'What caused us to lose our voices is still unclear, but no doubt it has close ties to Originium. Go, my sisters, go to Aefanyl's side.'
